recipes.oracle_text:
{G}{U}: This turn, each creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
{G}{U}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card.

recipe_coverage: Whole-Oracle counter-cost draw: actual source casting and entry counters, real counter removal as a paid activation cost, pending mana/counter/library receipts, actual drawing/discarding with ordered library and full zone identity, payer/source loss, repeated use and replay. Academy entry counts both graveyards and last-counter or zero-entry deaths. Novijen pays counters from one or multiple creatures. Sage actual Wizard/non-Wizard/opposing entry and Zameck both modes, stacked entry effects and functional cleanup are modeled. Novijen graft transfers remain dormant because no later creature enters. Replacement, control changes, and ambiguous mixed-hand source-bounce looting are explicit gaps. Authoritative native/Wasm validation is recorded in the wave5 report.
